title: Wherever I Look, There You Are; I
summary: Exhaustion is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this
lifeApplication: Choose one return that gives rest instead of one more noisy demand. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this
source.lifeApplication: Exhaustion becomes more truthful when wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this.

evidence.coreClaim: Wherever I look, there You are; I am totally convinced of this
evidence.turn: Exhaustion steadies when says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt; in this way, my essence merges.
